properties.description:
Making cutting-edge research accessible, one block at a time.

Industry, faced with decarbonization objectives for 2030 and beyond, needs accessible and tailored numerical simulation tools to accelerate innovation in the management and design of its processes and products. Current solutions, which are very costly and can only be used by trained experts, are struggling to meet these expectations.
DotBlocks aims to meet this need by offering an intuitive, no-code cloud platform, enabling manufacturers to rapidly design their own high-performance, tailor-made simulation tools, with the help of pre-coded components. This approach aims to democratize numerical simulation by making it usable without expertise or training, thus significantly speeding up manufacturers' innovation workflows by making numerical simulation accessible to all the technical teams involved in the development process.
